description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for creating or editing a 'Project' entity. It contains a stateful widget `ProjectFormPage` with form fields for project name, sort order, and color selection, handling form validation, state management, and interaction with a project repository.

classes.name: ProjectFormPage
classes.description: A Flutter widget that provides a form interface for creating or editing a Project.
